package.description: A modern, native Windows port of the GNOME Papers document viewer for PDFs, DjVu, Comic Books, and TIFFs.

en-US.description: A modern, native Windows port of the GNOME Papers document viewer for PDFs, DjVu, Comic Books, and TIFFs.
en-US.longDescription:
GNOME Papers is a modern document viewer designed for the GNOME desktop environment, now ported natively to Windows. It supports viewing multiple document formats, including PDF, DjVu, TIFF, and Comic Book Archives (CBR/CBZ).

Features:
- Native Windows Integration: Compiled natively using the UCRT64 toolchain.
- Platform Abstraction Layer: Custom Win32 platform integration for smooth gestures, scroll adjustments, and window rendering.
- File Associations: Automatically registers with Windows Default Apps for seamless double-click opening.
- Suppressed Console: Launches directly as a native GUI application without command prompt windows.
- Self-Contained: Includes all necessary GTK4, Libadwaita, Poppler, and icon assets.
en-US.name: GNOME Papers PDF reader
